Its strength builds across such a passage and peaks on the words that state an amount, degree or comparison (four, two, three, each, all, both, several, many, high, low), while it stays near zero on narrative, dialogue, clinical, legal, economic, mathematical and humanities prose, on code and on non-English text, even where those carry the same numerals and determiners.
